source_text: Non tradetur in manum cognati sanguinis ante iudicium. Iustitia misericordiae iuncta. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Not he-will-be-handed into hand of-kinsman of-blood before judgment. Justice of-mercy joined. Amen.
pass_b_english: He must not be handed to the blood-avenger before judgment. Justice joined to mercy. Amen.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
